case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1088 OF 2023 (Arising out of S.L.P. (Crl.) No.4517 of 2019)
summary: Sanction under Cr.P.C. s.197 for prosecution; police exceeding jurisdiction; arrest without authorization; illegal entry; assault; theft of gold chain and cash; no sanction required when acts not in official duty; High Court erred in quashing charges; charges restored.
final_judgment: Impugned High Court judgment set aside; charges framed by Trial Court restored; appeal allowed.
